name: Color Hide and Seek
desc:
🔥 Use code "like75k" and LIKE the game for free reward!!!
👍 NEW CODE releases once the game gets 80K LIKES!!!
🎁 Special code: "hide2023"

Seekers：Catch all players who haven't successfully hidden.
Hiders：According to the system prompt, hide next to the right color blocks.

At the beginning, one player gets chosen to be 'It'. 'It' has to try and find the other players. 'It' can run faster than everyone else, so the hiders should run near the right color blocks as quickly as possible to avoid being caught. So good luck and enjoy the game.

HideButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()MainFrame.Visible=false ShowButton.Visible=true end)ShowButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()MainFrame.Visible=true ShowButton.Visible=false end)local function NoclipLoop()if not isAutoWinEnabled then return end local char=LocalPlayer.Character if char then for _,part in pairs(char:GetDescendants())do if part:IsA("BasePart")and part.CanCollide then part.CanCollide=false end end end end local function GetTargetColor()for _,gui in pairs(LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:GetDescendants())do if gui:IsA("TextLabel")and gui.Text~=""and gui.Name~="Title"then local text=string.upper(gui.Text)local colors={"RED","BLUE","GREEN","YELLOW","BLACK","WHITE","PINK","PURPLE","ORANGE"}for _,colorName in ipairs(colors)do if string.find(text,colorName)or string.find(text,string.sub(colorName,2))then return colorName end end end end return nil end local function TeleportToColor(colorName)if not colorName then return end local colorMap={RED=Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0),BLUE=Color3.fromRGB(0,0,255),GREEN=Color3.fromRGB(0,255,0),YELLOW=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,0),BLACK=Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0),WHITE=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),PINK=Color3.fromRGB(255,105,180),PURPLE=Color3.fromRGB(160,32,240),ORANGE=Color3.fromRGB(255,165,0)}local targetColor3=colorMap[colorName]if not targetColor3 then return end local char=LocalPlayer.Character if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")then return end local myPos=char.HumanoidRootPart.Position local bestPart=nil local shortestDistance=math.huge for _,part in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants())do if part:IsA("BasePart")and part.CanCollide then local size=part.Size if size.X>=2 and size.X<=15 and size.Y>=2 and size.Y<=15 and size.Z>=2 and size.Z<=15 then local colorDiff=(part.Color.R-targetColor3.R)^2+(part.Color.G-targetColor3.G)^2+(part.Color.B-targetColor3.B)^2 if colorDiff<0.05 then local dist=(part.Position-myPos).Magnitude if dist<shortestDistance then shortestDistance=dist bestPart=part end end end end end if bestPart then char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame=bestPart.CFrame+Vector3.new(0,0,0)end end AutoWinButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()isAutoWinEnabled=not isAutoWinEnabled if isAutoWinEnabled then AutoWinButton.Text="Auto Win: ON"AutoWinButton.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(0,150,0)noclipConnection=RunService.Stepped:Connect(NoclipLoop)autoWinConnection=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()local char=LocalPlayer.Character if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")then return end if tick()-lastTeleportTime<0.3 then return end local currentColor=GetTargetColor()if currentColor then TeleportToColor(currentColor)lastTeleportTime=tick()end end)else AutoWinButton.Text="Auto Win: OFF"AutoWinButton.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(50,50,50)if autoWinConnection then autoWinConnection:Disconnect()autoWinConnection=nil end if noclipConnection then noclipConnection:Disconnect()noclipConnection=nil end local char=LocalPlayer.Character if char then for _,part in pairs(char:GetDescendants())do if part:IsA("BasePart")then part.CanCollide=true end end end end end)game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification",{Title="RanoYSD";Text="Меню наверху. Noclip + телепорт внутрь блока.";Duration=5;})
